get.summary: Gets a specific feature associated with a license by id.
Search for features associated with a license.
get.description:
The Zywave API search is implemented using [OData Version 4.0.1](https://www.odata.org/documentation/).

 The following OData filter operations are supported by the Zywave API; each is accompanied by an example request.
 
 | Operation | Example Request | Returns |
 | ------- | -------- | -------- |
 | startswith   | startswith(Name,'Zyw')    | Returns all features where the name starts with 'Zyw'    |
 | endswith | endswith(Name,'wave') | Returns all features where the name ends with 'wave' |
 | contains   | contains(Name,'wave')    | Returns all features where the name contains 'wave'    |
 | Equals   | Name eq 'Zywave'    | Returns all features named Zywave    |
 | Not Equals   | Name ne 'Zywave'    | Returns all features not named Zywave    |
 | In   | Name in ('Zyw', 'ave')    | Returns all features with the names 'Zyw' or 'ave'.    |
 | Not   | not startswith(Name,'Zyw')    | Returns all features with a name that doesn't start with ‘Zyw’    |

 The Zywave API also supports the And operation which will allow for multiple search criteria to be applied to a single request. For example, the following filter will return all enabled features with a name containing "Zywave";
  

   *contains(Name,'Zywave') and IsEnabled eq true*

  
 The orderby operation also supports multiple levels of ordering. For example, to order the results by name and description, the following can be used;
 

   *Name asc, Description asc*

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: The search criteria for the request. To view a list of supported search operations and the properties which can be searched see the documentation above.

parameters.name: $orderBy
parameters.description: Defines the order in which the results are returned. To view a list of properties that can be used in ordering see the documentation above.

parameters.name: $skip
parameters.description: The number of total records to skip before displaying the first result. For example, if there are 10 total records and $skip is set to 5 the first record shown in the response will be the 6th record returned. In order to avoid an error please ensure that the $skip is dividable by the $top.

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: The total number of records returned in the response. In order to avoid an error please ensure that the $skip is dividable by the $top.

get.summary: Gets a dictionary of feature and license data for the active profile.

parameters.name: effectiveDateTime
parameters.description: Restricts feature and license data to only licenses active at the specified time. If omitted, all feature and license data is returned.

parameters.name: includeDisabled
parameters.description: Determines if disabled features are to be included. Defaults to false.

200.description: A dictionary of feature and license data for the active profile.

get.summary: Gets a specific license by id.

get.description:
The Zywave API search is implemented using [OData Version 4.0.1](https://www.odata.org/documentation/).

 The following OData filter operations are supported by the Zywave API; each is accompanied by an example request.
 
 | Operation | Example Request | Returns |
 | ------- | -------- | -------- |
 | startswith   | startswith(Name,'Zyw')    | Returns all licenses where the name starts with 'Zyw'    |
 | endswith | endswith(Name,'wave') | Returns all licenses where the name ends with 'wave' |
 | contains   | contains(Name,'wave')    | Returns all licenses where the name contains 'wave'    |
 | Equals   | Name eq 'Zywave'    | Returns all licenses named Zywave    |
 | Not Equals   | Name ne 'Zywave'    | Returns all licenses not named Zywave    |
 | Greater Than   | StartDateTime gt 2020-04-01T10:00:00.000Z      | Returns all licenses with a StartDateTime after 10:00: on April 1st    |
 | Greater Than or equal   | StartDateTime ge 2020-04-01T10:00:00.000Z    | Returns all licenses with a StartDateTime after 10:00 on April 1st. Note: Timestamp matters    |
 | Less Than   | StartDateTime lt 2020-04-01T10:00:00.000Z       | Returns all licenses with a StartDateTime before 10:00 on April 1st    |
 | Less Than or equal     | StartDateTime le 2020-04-01T10:00:00.000Z       | Returns all licenses with a StartDateTime at or before 10:00 on April 1st. Note: Timestamp matters    |
 | In   | Name in ('Zyw', 'ave')    | Returns all licenses with the names 'Zyw' or 'ave'.    |
 | Not   | not startswith(Name,'Zyw')    | Returns all licenses with a name that doesn't start with ‘Zyw’    |
 When searching the Zywave API using DateTime the following format should be used YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.fffZ.
 The Zywave API also supports the And operation which will allow for multiple search criteria to be applied to a single request. For example, the following filter will return all licenses with the name Zywave that have have a start date after January 2020;
  

   *Name eq 'Zywave' and StartDateTime ge 2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z

  
 The orderby operation also supports multiple levels of ordering. For example, to order the results by name showing the licenses that ended most recently first, the following can be used;
 

   *Name asc, EndDateTime desc*
